steps.en: After the first letter, the notice is picked for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Setelah surat pertama, notice dipilih untuk pengingat elektronik
steps.why_en: The selection is generic, not built for these notices, and the job is switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Pemilihannya generik, bukan khusus notice ini, dan job-nya dimatikan di pengaturan.

steps.en: OCMS checks the latest mobile number of the offender
steps.id: OCMS mengecek nomor mobile terbaru offender
steps.why_en: The check is switched off in the settings, so the saved number is used as it is.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan dimatikan di pengaturan, sehingga nomor yang tersimpan dipakai apa adanya.

steps.en: The new mobile number is saved on the offender record
steps.id: Nomor mobile baru disimpan di record offender
steps.why_en: Saving happens only inside the check that is switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan hanya terjadi di dalam pengecekan yang dimatikan di pengaturan.

steps.en: With no valid number, no electronic reminder is sent
steps.id: Tanpa nomor yang valid, pengingat elektronik tidak dikirim
steps.why_en: The skip logic exists, but number format is barely checked and the job is switched off.
steps.why_id: Logic lewati ada, tetapi format nomor nyaris tidak dicek dan job-nya dimatikan.
